meta.description: Peptide-spectrum matching from MS/MS with target-decoy FDR control, covering verified Comet, MS-GF+, Sage, Percolator, pyOpenMS, concatenated and separate target-decoy searches, q-values, and PEP.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical claims in the audit were asserted against synthetic ground truth or freshly produced public PXD070049 outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill addresses analytical peptide identification and routes clinical or downstream interpretation outside its scope.

methodological_ground.detail: The runs confirmed search-mode-specific FDR estimators, decoy-prefix handling, score orientation, and separate PSM versus protein-level control.

code_usability.detail: All advertised Python scripts and the Sage, Comet, MS-GF+, and Percolator routes executed with parsed, asserted outputs.

functional_suitability.note: Complete verified routes cover in-process search, tables, separate searches, DDA engines, and rescoring.

reliability.note: Major failure modes are explicit, including missing decoys and Percolator failure; malformed tables still rely on pandas errors.

performance_context.note: The concise entry point delegates detail to references and scripts; real database searching remains necessarily compute-heavy.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, command routes, expected artifacts, and common-error guidance are consistent and actionable.

human_usability.note: The description and usage guide expose natural requests and clear scope boundaries.

security.note: No credentials, network calls, or unsafe evaluation are present; normal local input paths are intentionally caller-provided.

maintainability.note: Runnable components have focused responsibilities and match the documented reference paths.

agent_specific.note: Progressive disclosure, related-skill handoffs, idempotent output routing, and stop conditions are strong; local tool paths still require environment configuration.

key_strengths: Every advertised executable route was freshly run and its output parsed rather than trusting exit status.
The Skill distinguishes concatenated competition, separate-search pi0 estimation, q-values, PEP, and protein-level scope correctly.
The DDA executor now gives an explicit, early decoy-label error and supports pooled runs.
All 46 Phase-2 assertions passed on synthetic ground truth or public PXD070049 data.
